_comment: Hand-verified Find Shows banner photos, one per event slug. Read by lib/find-shows/hero-image-registry.ts. An entry is added only after the source page itself (a heading, caption or alt text next to the image) or the image content ties the photo to this event and edition; file names, upload paths, EXIF and dimensions are never enough on their own. Previous-edition photos must set previousEdition and are labelled with their own year on the banner.
